title: Systematic Failures in Collective Reasoning under Distributed Information in Multi-Agent LLMs
intervention: Hidden versus full information; pre/post discussion; forced disclosure and secretary ablations.
estimand: Collective post-discussion accuracy minus local pre-discussion or full-information accuracy; no matched private re-update identified in inspected design.
reported_result: Distributed accuracy 30.1% versus full-information 80.7%; Reveal-All GPT-4.1 92.6%, Gemini-2.5-Flash 98.2%.
causal_limit: Disclosure changes the communication process; not the E9 four-cell receiver interaction.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced

title: Diverse Evidence, Better Forecasts: Multi-Agent Deliberation Under Information Asymmetry
venue: Preprint; no peer-reviewed venue independently established
intervention: Public/private evidence partition, rationale sharing, number of rounds, routing and aggregation ablations.
estimand: System forecast-score changes for component interventions; reported ablations vary one component at a time.
datasets: PolyGym: 375 binary Polymarket questions; fixed pre-retrieved pool.
reported_result: InfoDelphi Brier .178/77.9% accuracy; no deliberation .206/74.1%; all-public .193/75.7%; no rationale sharing .211/70.4%.
causal_limit: Not a crossed receiver-source-access versus matched private-update design.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced

title: When Debate Helps: Proposal Supply and Verification-Aware Readout in Multi-Agent Reasoning
venue: Preprint; no peer-reviewed venue independently established
intervention: Fixed target/question/initial response/candidate set; vary controlled correct support, neutral messages and answer-stripped correct/wrong rationales.
estimand: Answer-log-probability margin shifts and generated accuracy changes conditional on selected mixed-correctness traces.
datasets: Reasoning benchmarks; fixed-proposal probes on GPQA and MMLU-Redux, 50 traces/backbone-dataset.
reported_result: At three correct-support messages, accuracy differences +.14/+.04 for Qwen3-4B and +.56/+.58 for OLMo3-7B.
short_extract: We vary only the peer evidence
causal_limit: Gold-conditioned probe selection/content; no receiver document-access interaction identified.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced

title: AgentWebBench: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Coordination in Agentic Web
venue: Preprint; no peer-reviewed venue independently established
intervention: Centralized retrieval versus embedding-selected or LLM-selected site tools versus autonomous content-agent interaction.
estimand: End-to-end strategy comparisons, including retrieval, planning, summaries and interaction changes.
datasets: 100 websites/18.4M documents; MS MARCO 354 queries, ORBIT 281 histories, DeepResearchGym 53 QA and 331 research queries.
reported_result: Decentralized methods generally trail centralized access; some QA comparisons reverse; content-agent retrieval/planning are identified bottlenecks.
short_extract: It has no direct corpus access
causal_limit: No controlled receiver access/consultation interaction. HTML header says August 24, 2026 despite v1 submission April 13; date mismatch retained.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced

title: MASS-RAG: Multi-Agent Synthesis Retrieval-Augmented Generation
intervention: Summarizer, extractor and reasoner process the same retrieved documents; optional answer stage and synthesis.
estimand: Architecture/role ablations and postselected uniquely attributable evidence coverage; not randomized recipient source access.
reported_result: Table 4 Llama3 TriviaQA synthesis 76.7 versus summarizer 73.7; PopQA synthesis 64.2 versus summarizer 65.7. Synthesis is not uniformly best.
causal_limit: Agent complementarity and answer synthesis are already explicit; ECR subsets are selected after observing outputs.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced

title: Sufficient Context: A New Lens on Retrieval Augmented Generation Systems
intervention: Define/label context sufficiency, stratify RAG errors, combine confidence and sufficiency for selective generation.
estimand: Predominantly stratified performance and selective-generation comparisons, not randomized source-access effects.
datasets: FreshQA, MuSiQue-Ans, HotpotQA; 115 human-labeled challenging examples for autorater evaluation.
reported_result: Reported autorater accuracy 93%; strong models can answer 35-62% of insufficient-context cases correctly.
causal_limit: Missing benchmark support is not proof of insufficiency or inability to answer from model knowledge.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced

title: MuSiQue: Multihop Questions via Single-hop Question Composition
reviewed_version: Official ACL Anthology metadata and abstract
sections_read: Official abstract and bibliographic record only
intervention: Compose connected single-hop questions with filters; add unanswerable contrasts in MuSiQue-Full.
estimand: Benchmark construction/answerability contrast; no collaboration intervention.
datasets: MuSiQue-Ans: 25K, 2-4 hops; MuSiQue-Full adds unanswerable contrast questions.
reported_result: Abstract reports a 30-point single-hop F1 reduction relative to existing shortcut-prone datasets.
causal_limit: Dataset provenance verified; no full-PDF methodological audit in this review. Existing contrasts are not a new benchmark contribution.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced

title: HotpotQA: A Dataset for Diverse, Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering
reviewed_version: Official ACL Anthology record and author dataset site
sections_read: Official abstract, metadata and author dataset description
intervention: Collect multi-document Wikipedia QA with sentence-level supporting facts.
estimand: Benchmark evaluation; no recipient consultation treatment.
reported_result: Supporting-fact supervision is reported to improve benchmark performance; no new numerical claim relied on here.
causal_limit: Annotated support supplies candidate documents, not an independent proof that each document is necessary in the retained six-document context.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced

title: MasRouter: Learning to Route LLMs for Multi-Agent Systems
intervention: Learn collaboration mode, role allocation and model routing with a cost-performance objective.
estimand: Performance/cost of learned complete systems; component ablations.
reported_result: MBPP pass@1 84.00 versus AFlow/gpt-4o-mini 82.20; reported HumanEval overhead reduction up to 52.07%.
causal_limit: Routing is established; E9 alone neither learns nor validates a deployable consultation policy.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced

title: What Should Agents Say? Action-state Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Systems
venue: Preprint; no peer-reviewed venue independently established
intervention: Compare five message formats in split-evidence interaction and a four-role pipeline; introduce PACT action/state/result packets.
estimand: Format-induced end-to-end quality and token changes with scaffold fixed.
datasets: HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA; reasoning pipeline and coding harness evaluations.
reported_result: No uniformly best naive format; paper reports 38.7% mean token reduction across baselines/model scales.
causal_limit: Recipient rereading costs and split-evidence QA are explicit. E9 cannot claim either discovery; calls do not measure realized cost.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced

title: Single-Agent LLMs Outperform Multi-Agent Systems on Multi-Hop Reasoning Under Equal Thinking Token Budgets
venue: Preprint; no peer-reviewed venue independently established
intervention: Compare single-agent and five multi-agent architectures under thinking budgets; perturbation sensitivity.
reported_result: Single agents generally match/exceed multi-agent alternatives; heavy masking/substitution can reverse comparisons.
short_extract: only to the generated think text
causal_limit: Section 5.3 describes context corruption, but Appendix E applies it to generated thought text. No code audit here resolves that internal scope tension; DPI does not prove a practical frozen model always wins.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced

title: Beyond Perfect Teammates: Multi-Agent Collaboration with Unreliable Colleagues
venue: Preprint; no peer-reviewed venue independently established
intervention: Paired Reliable/Misaligned/Incomplete/Missed colleague behavior; executable answer-uniqueness and role-necessity checks.
estimand: Behavior-profile differences in main-agent final accuracy/interaction rounds with task and ground truth fixed.
datasets: UnCoBench: 1000 paired task groups, 4000 variants/model, 10 models.
reported_result: GPT-5.6 Sol Reliable 98.7%, Incomplete 77.0%; mean rounds 2.18 versus 2.93.
short_extract: truthful but no longer uniquely determines
causal_limit: Changes collaborator behavior and adaptive recovery; not matched private revision of one cached receiver.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced

title: M3-ACE: Rectifying Visual Perception in Multimodal Math Reasoning via Multi-Agentic Context Engineering
venue: Preprint; no peer-reviewed venue independently established
intervention: Anchor revises visual evidence using frozen assistant evidence/answers, summary and filtering tools; compare self-reflection.
estimand: Method and diagnostic correction comparisons, including idealized gold-supervision probes.
reported_result: No-new-information reflection has little benefit in inspected diagnostics; paper reports MathVision 89.1.
causal_limit: Frozen peer contexts are established. Visual-perception errors differ from randomized source access; no E9 four-cell estimand identified.
verification_level: Independent targeted primary-source reading; not reproduced
